scope: Catalog actions for the one shared Claude Code and Codex memory stack (memory system, embedder, reranker, memory LLM and local serving) from a cross-family blind convergence: two frozen packets went to blind Claude Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6 Astra lanes, three roles went to a blind GPT-6 Sol judge in three presentation orders, the coordinator's convergence table set each row, two skeptic checks per row reviewed it, and neutral Mac measurements in the LongMemEval-S harness bound the memory-system and embedder rows. Production stays as configured; no row is adopted.

publication_policy.best_means: best-evidenced for this workload on these hosts on 2026-09-25, never state of the art in general

decision_values.retain: Keep the current production choice or as-shipped control; it stays until a challenger passes the preregistered rule.
decision_values.trial: Measure in isolation (VelaNext, a trial profile, loopback services, native passwordless sign-in), pinned to an official artifact by version and digest; no production wiring.
decision_values.defer: Record with the named gate or test that would reopen it; nothing is installed.
decision_values.reject: Not for this role this wave, with the condition that would reopen it.
decision_values.adopt_within_scope: Not used: it needs native_cli_execution in our harness plus a pass of the memory-lane acceptance, and no row has both.

evidence_levels.mac_nce_descriptive: native_cli_execution in our LongMemEval-S harness on the Mac (full track, n = 470, recall_all@5), descriptive under A15.2, plus discovery evidence
evidence_levels.discovery_independent: discovery: a leaderboard or independent source named in the row, with or without vendor claims; no NCE
evidence_levels.discovery_vendor: discovery, vendor claims only (DV) or none; no NCE
evidence_levels.operational_record: an operational or production record outside the harness (a runbook smoke test, a production setting, a catalog status or a bug report); no NCE for this role
evidence_levels.model_task_execution_other_workload: model_task_execution on VelaNext for a different workload; no embedding evidence and no NCE

evidence_classes_in_text.NCE: native_cli_execution: measured in our LongMemEval-S harness (Mac, full track, n = 470, recall_all@5); descriptive under A15.2, with confirmatory decisions from the VelaNext rerun
evidence_classes_in_text.D: discovery: a leaderboard or independent source named in the row

production_baseline: ai-memory 19b6429 (local 2.5 build) on Ollama 0.34.4 with qwen3-embedding:4b and qwen3.5-9b-64k (qwen3.5:9b-mlx) for consolidation and LLM reranking; QMD for selected document collections. This record changes none of it.
replacement_rule: A challenger replaces production only if it beats both C3 and C4 (A14 intersection–union) under Holm within each family (α = 0.0333; A16 arms at 0.0167) with a significant gain of at least +5 pp (A2, A15.2), then passes the deployable-artifact gate where it applies and the memory-lane acceptance: an explicit durable decision retrievable in its intended scope with cross-scope negatives, and recovery without importing unrelated histories or another host's credential store.
